criterion: 尚無程式的設計草案可依設計條件檢查，不被實作證據缺失誤擋；必要可行性分析不能跳過；實作偏差及欠缺驗收證據分別被指出。缺資料不阻擋無相依工作，同範圍修復不重複授權，實質契約變更不得沿用舊授權。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Domain/OS checks distinguish design feasibility, implementation conformance and actual acceptance. Recovery rechecks retained authority without requiring the failed global acceptance gate; no new authorization is manufactured.
